title: Acne Studios Loose-Fit Wide-Leg Terry Pants (5-pocket sweatpant-jean)
sizing: Get XL (largest). Chart (length / 1/2-waist=full / hip-full): S 106/74/86, M 108/78/90, L 110/82/94, XL 112/86/98. For 183cm/75kg (waist 89, hips 94-95): waist is jean-style FIXED (belt loops, fly) but fabric is soft cotton FRENCH TERRY with give — XL full waist 86 stretches onto your 89 (snug at natural waist, wearable); L 82 too tight. Hip XL 98 = good ease over 94-95; L hip 94 = no room. Length 112 long wide-leg. Same XL he lands on for Logan's other bottoms. Fit = fitted-waist / roomy-hip / wide-leg; no size bigger than XL if more waist room wanted.

size_chart.note: 1/2 Waist = half; full = x2. Hipline = full. Measuring error 1-3cm. Jean-style fixed waistband in stretchy cotton terry.
